title: Invoice
key_sentences: Thank you for choosing us for the classroom storage project.
This invoice covers the second and final stage of the works described in quotation Q-2026-112.
The works were completed on 9 October 2026 and signed off by your site manager.
We guarantee all fitted furniture for five years from the date of installation.
If you have any questions about this invoice, please contact our accounts team.

rows: Oak veneer storage unit, 1800 × 900 mm, with adjustable shelves
Coat hook rail in solid ash 1200 mm long, eight hooks
Reading nook bench with lift-up lid
Removal and disposal of old fittings

list_items.text: Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date.
We accept bank transfer and cheque.
Please quote the invoice number as your reference.
Cheques should be made payable to Harrow & Finch Joinery Ltd.
Late payments may incur interest at 4% above base rate.
All goods remain our property until paid in full.

notes: Single-page trade invoice. Letterhead (four lines, top left) is furniture; the boxed panel at top right (Invoice number, dates, references) is a key/value table with no header row, listed first in tables. 'Bill to' and 'Deliver to' are two side-by-side boxes whose reading order is box by box, left box first; their labels are box labels, not headings. Line-item table is a full grid; item 2's description cell has two lines (joined with one space); the four total rows merge the first five columns, so the merged text repeats five times. The payment-details panel is a boxed key/value table without header. Terms list: disc and circle markers drawn by CSS (not in the text). The footer line is a CSS page-margin box.
